component.title: ErrorBoundary
component.purpose: Contain render failures, preserve unaffected context, and provide honest recovery without exposing unsafe diagnostics by default.

states.description: A failed region exposes contextual recovery and optional safe diagnostics.
Retry clears the boundary and lets the consumer restore the failed region.

claims.statement: The boundary replaces only its failed subtree; the host surface remains mounted.
The failure fallback exposes a keyboard-operable retry action and reset-key recovery without automatic focus capture.
Technical details are opt-in and bounded to the error message rather than exposing a raw stack by default.
Contained errors remain legible across native and compatible preview kits.
